annotations.title: Redesign a house exterior or yard

description: AI exterior design and landscaping: restyle the outside of a house or building for curb appeal (siding, paint, trim, roof color, front door) or redesign a yard, patio or garden, from a photo. Returns a photorealistic image of the new design. Uses one House AI design credit.

color_palette.description: Optional palette, for example 'warm tones' or 'earth tones'.
color_palette.title: Color Palette

focus.description: 'building' restyles the house or facade; 'landscaping' redesigns the yard or garden.
focus.title: Focus

notes.description: Anything specific the user asked for, in their words (for example 'keep the fireplace').
notes.title: Notes

photo.description: The room or house photo the user attached in chat. Filled in by the app, not typed.

photo_upload_id.description: The upload_id from get_photo_upload_link, once the user says the photo is uploaded.
photo_upload_id.title: Photo Upload Id

photo_url.description: A public https link to the photo, if the user gave one instead of attaching it.
photo_url.title: Photo Url

style.description: Exterior or landscaping style, for example 'modern farmhouse', 'Mediterranean', 'English garden'.
style.title: Style

name: redesign_exterior
title: Redesign a house exterior or yard
